# temps_environment (Data Source)

Looks up a project environment by name, typically the `production` environment Temps creates with every project. Needs the `environments:read` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every project has a production environment.
data "temps_environment" "production" {
  project_id = data.temps_project.web.id
  name       = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Environment name or slug, for example `production`.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Read-Only

- `branch` (String) Deployed branch.
- `id` (String) Numeric environment ID.
- `is_preview` (Boolean) Whether it is a preview environment.
- `main_url` (String) Primary URL.
- `slug` (String) Environment slug.
- `subdomain` (String) Subdomain.
